mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for July 21, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Gaza celebrates World Cup victory of Spanish team they took into their hearts. People gather at cafes and outdoor screenings to support team after Spain's backing for Palestinian rights. This was reported by The Guardian. 2. Hamas names Khalil al-Hayya as new overall leader. The Palestinian armed group's Qatar-based chief negotiator replaces Yahya Sinwar, who was killed by Israeli forces in Gaza in 2024. This was reported by BBC News. 3. Five Palestinians killed in fire after Israeli attack in Gaza. An Israeli air attack on an apartment in Gaza City set the building on fire, killing five people. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 4. Muslim leader speaks out after more than 80 days in ICE detention: 'It brought back memories from Palestine'. Salah Sarsour, president of Wisconsin's largest mosque, said 'dehumanizing' treatment reminded him of time spent in Israeli military jail. This was reported by The Guardian.
